He was a disciple of Sheikh Jamal-ud-Din Muhammad Hamadani and spent most of his life in the vicinity of Lahore.

Intekhab, also known as Inayat Khan, was an influential Sufi master and musician born in 1882 in present-day Pakistan. He is considered the founder of the Sufi Order International, which has centers around the world and focuses on the integration of Sufi teachings with modern life.
